summary: The finding matrix covers CL-01 through CL-17 and all 25 September IDs. PR #666 is merged; backend, bot, Stability Pool, AMM, and Analytics run its reviewed builds, and the wallet-session frontend is published. Partial Points provenance, one legacy archive-proof case, and 60 Treasury tombstones remain bounded historical limitations rather than active-path blockers.
plainSummary: The accepted active-path security fixes are merged and installed, including all five dependency updates and the wallet frontend. Historical cases without exact proof remain safely held, and the public report keeps those limits visible. Rob does not need to act right now.
